falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the 77% bottom_2024_aug pattern match, as that bottom preceded a grinding recovery with no immediate breakout; this signals the 'bottom' was actually a continuation pattern, not a reversal

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained sub-12 VIX would contradict the elevated uncertainty regime implied by a bottom formation; it would indicate complacency rather than the lingering fear/hesitation typical of post-bottom basing, invalidating the HOLD signal

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 2+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-quality bid this strong would signal recession/de-risking rather than the soft-landing/growth-stabilization environment that typically validates a market bottom; the pattern match to Aug 2024 occurred during growth-scare stabilization, not recession pricing

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
